items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: My father? John W. Simmons. And he goes by the name of J.W.

ctx.x: My father? John W. Simmons. And he goes by the name of J.W. He's alive, in Oklahoma City. Jive, henpecked. Incidentally, I called him last night and told him how henpecked he was. He says, "Is that what you call me, boy?" I say, "Yeah." Say, "What you want me to do?" I say, "I want you to be a man." "Well, if I was you and you was me, I wouldn't talk to my father like that." I said, "I'm not talking to you like a father," I said, "I'm talking to you man to man," I said. "Like, I can't recognize you as a father,"…
You left Haskell when you were five.
